name: askdare starter
description: A Next.js app with an askdare chat: one bot, one route and one script tag.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: A key from a dedicated OpenAI project with a hard spend limit.

CHAT_SECRET.description: Signs visitor sessions. Generated for you; keep it different from your other environments.

ASKDARE_MODEL.description: A current OpenAI model your project may use. The build fails without it.

ASKDARE_INSTRUCTIONS.description: What the bot does and how it answers. The reply language follows the visitor's.
ASKDARE_INSTRUCTIONS.value: You are the assistant on our website. Answer briefly and politely. If you do not know something, say so.

ASKDARE_GREETING.description: The first message in the chat.

ASKDARE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Other sites that may embed the chat, comma-separated, e.g. https://www.example.com. Empty: only this app.
